highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds missing tvOS surface overloads and strengthens native package protections.
highlights_body: It also preserves Android symbols for improved diagnostics in deployed applications.

bullets.detail: tvOS applications can use the missing SKSurface.Create overloads already available on the related Apple targets.
Android symbol assets are packaged for more useful native crash diagnostics.

contributor_summaries.MartinZikmund: Added missing tvOS SKSurface creation overloads

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Preview 3 completed native binary hardening for the servicing release.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 added Windows native hardening and tvOS API coverage.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 introduced Android symbol packaging and the initial servicing changes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp receives the accompanying native binary hardening updates.
